Maria G.: FYI the new eval run against llama-3-8q failed in the runner, but the GitHub CI job didn't fail. eval-bot flagged a potential dataset leakage. Logs below.

Maria G.: ```
ERROR runner.core: Unexpected token mismatch during postprocess
leakage_check.py: found 12 exact matches between eval prompts and training_corpus_v2.zip
metrics.reporter: reported EM drop -4.2, BLEU +1.1 (weird)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runner/exec.py", line 223, in run_eval
    results = evaluator.evaluate(cfg)
  File "evaluator/core.py", line 87, in evaluate
    raise RuntimeError("Postprocess failed: token id mismatch")
RuntimeError: Postprocess failed: token id mismatch
```

Owen K.: Can you paste the GH action + runner config? wonder if CI suppressed failures.

Maria G.: snippet from .github/workflows/evals.yml: ```yaml
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  eval-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: pip install -r infra/eval-requirements.txt
      - run: python -m evals.runner --config evals/configs/llama-3-8q.yml
    # note: we forgot to set fail_on_regression: true in action wrapper
```

Amelia L.: Runner bug suspicion: when cache_enabled==true and quantized model uses token_type mapping, postprocess can remap ids and produce false exact-match hits (looks like leakage but actually tokenization drift). Seen this with group-quantize configs.

Reza P.: I can repro locally. Steps: checkout branch, pip install -e ., then
```bash
python -m evals.runner --model llama-3-8q --quantize "--bits 8 --group 32" --dataset evalsets/qa_v2.jsonl
```
Result: token ids differ at positions with multi-byte whitespace, causing the leakage checker to treat normalized prompt as identical.

Maria G.: Ok two action items: (1) CI should fail when runner returns non-zero or when eval-bot reports regression above threshold, (2) leakage check needs to be stricter (ngram overlap + canonicalized normalization). Also need a synthetic fixture to catch the tokenization drift.

Owen K.: For CI wiring, add a required status check `eval-check` and in the action step after runner do `if grep -q "REGRESSION" results.json; then exit 1; fi` or better: return nonzero from runner. I'll add a GH action matrix for model_variant so it runs quantized variants.

Amelia L.: Metric defs: we currently use EM (exact match) but for ops with subtokenization drift EM will be noisy. Propose adding MRR and normalized-levenshtein (fuzzy) as first-class metrics, and publishing sacrebleu for translation-like tasks. Also split the metric thresholds by model_variant (8q vs float16).

Reza P.: I'll add a leakage filter that computes ngram_jaccard and flags only if jaccard >= 0.85 AND exact match after strict canonicalization. Also adding a synthetic generator script to create near-duplicate prompts: infra/eval-fixtures/synthetic_token_drift.jsonl

Maria G.: Good. For dashboards: current Grafana panel shows `eval.mean_score` which hides regressions by averaging. We want: `eval.rollup.mrr`, per-model-variant panels, and an `eval.regression_tag` annotation that links to the failing run + PR. Also add alerts for sustained EM drop > 3% over a week.

eval-bot: Eval-run 1717648200 completed: 1 failure, 2 warnings. Results: /evals/1717648200 (leakage suspected).

Owen K.: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR to change the action to fail on nonzero runner exit and add matrix for variants.

Reza P.: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1287 (WIP) - adds leakage filter, synthetic fixture, and a runner fix for token remap. Assigning @Owen K. for review.

Amelia L.: Also add a CI job that runs a tiny smoke eval with the synthetic fixture at PR time (fast and catches tokenization drift).

Maria G.: Thanks all. Next: after PR merged, I'll kick a full eval and update the Grafana panel with the new rollup metrics. Also need an entry in dataset registry: add dataset_version: qa_v2-2024-06-05 and provenance notes to prevent accidental reuse.

Owen K.: I'll follow up in the PR with the required status check change and GH protection rules.

Maria G.: Filed issue to track: #987 (Eval harness: runner/CI/leakage + dashboard improvements).

Reza P.: Patch pushed to PR, CI green on unit-tests, running eval smoke now.

Maria G.: Awesome — feel free to ping me when smoke finishes.

Amelia L.: Ping on merge, I'll add the fuzzy metrics and dashboards.

eval-bot: Note: next run will include synthetic fixtures if present at path infra/eval-fixtures/synthetic_token_drift.jsonl.

Maria G.: Closing loop here — will verify after the merge. Thanks! :rocket:
